children: Callan JMB's Mark Meller resigned from the company's board of directors and as chair of the audit committee, effective August 26, 2026.
Member of the Board of Directors; Chair of the Audit Committee; Member of the Governance and Compensation Committee

Related to governance arrangements contemplated by Asset Purchase and Sale Agreement with Reger Oil, Inc.; resignation not due to any disagreement with the Company on operations, policies or practices

Pursuant to the APA, holders of a majority of the stated value of the Company's Series A perpetual convertible preferred stock issued to Seller will nominate and elect a replacement upon closing; if the transaction is not consummated, remaining directors will fill the vacancy per bylaws
Resigned as chair of the audit committee and as member of the governance and compensation committee
